quests.instruction: Which word begins with the blend /s/ + /t/?
quests.hint: Listen for two sounds at the start: first a hiss, then a quick tap.
quests.explanation: “Stop” begins with the blend st: /s/ then /t/. “Top” only has /t/, and “shop” starts with /sh/.
quests.funFact: Many English words begin with s plus another consonant, like stop, spin and skip.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with /sp/?
quests.hint: The word you want starts with a hiss and a puff, one right after the other.
quests.explanation: “Spin” starts with /s/ and /p/ blended together. “Pin” and “sin” only have one starting sound.
quests.funFact: In a blend, you can still hear each letter’s sound if you say it slowly.

quests.instruction: Which blend starts “skip”?
quests.hint: Say skip very slowly. The second sound is made at the back of your throat.
quests.explanation: “Skip” starts with the blend sk: /s/ and /k/.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with the blend /sl/?
quests.hint: Say the first two sounds separately. Do you hear a hiss and then an /l/?
quests.explanation: “Slip” starts with /s/ and /l/. “Lip” only has /l/, and “ship” starts with the digraph /sh/.
quests.funFact: Slip and ship look alike, but sl is a blend with two sounds and sh is a digraph with one.

quests.instruction: Which blend do you hear at the start of “snap”?
quests.hint: Say the word slowly and pay attention to the second sound.
quests.explanation: “Snap” starts with /s/ and /n/. Changing the second sound would give “smap” or “slap”.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with /sm/?
quests.hint: Close your lips on the second sound.
quests.explanation: “Smell” starts with the blend sm. “Spell” starts with sp and “sell” has only one starting sound.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with the blend /bl/?
quests.hint: Say the first two sounds: a lip pop, then /l/.
quests.explanation: “Block” starts with /b/ and /l/. “Lock” has only /l/, and “clock” starts with /k/ and /l/.

quests.instruction: Which two sounds start “flag”?
quests.hint: Say flag slowly. Which sound comes after /f/?
quests.explanation: “Flag” starts with /f/ and /l/. Other blends would make different words, or no word at all.
quests.funFact: Bl, cl, fl, gl, pl and sl are called l-blends because /l/ is the second sound.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with /pl/?
quests.hint: Count the sounds at the start: you should hear /p/ and then /l/.
quests.explanation: “Plan” starts with the blend pl. “Pan” has only /p/ and “clan” starts with cl.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with the blend /dr/?
quests.hint: Say the first two sounds of each word. One has /d/ and then /r/.
quests.explanation: “Drip” starts with /d/ and /r/. “Trip” starts with /t/ and /r/, and “dip” has no /r/.
quests.funFact: Br, cr, dr, fr, gr, pr and tr are called r-blends because /r/ is the second sound.

quests.instruction: Which blend starts “crab”?
quests.hint: Say crab slowly. The first sound is made at the back of your throat.
quests.explanation: “Crab” starts with /k/ and /r/. “Gr” would give “grab”, and “br” would give “brab”.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with /fr/?
quests.hint: Look for two sounds at the start: /f/ and then /r/.
quests.explanation: “Frog” starts with /f/ and /r/. “Fog” has no /r/, and “flop” has /f/ and /l/.

quests.instruction: In “ship”, the letters sh make one sound. In “slip”, the letters s and l make two. How many sounds does “slip” have?
quests.hint: Tap out each sound: /s/, /l/, then the vowel and the last consonant.
quests.explanation: “Slip” has 4 sounds: /s/ /l/ /i/ /p/. “Ship” has only 3 because sh is a digraph.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a blend, not a digraph?
quests.hint: A blend has two separate sounds. A digraph makes one new sound.
quests.explanation: “Stop” starts with /s/ and /t/, two separate sounds. “Shop” and “chop” start with digraphs.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a digraph, not a blend?
quests.hint: Ask yourself: can I hear two separate sounds, or just one?
quests.explanation: “Chip” starts with the digraph ch, one sound. “Clip” and “slip” start with blends.
quests.funFact: A blend is like two friends standing side by side. A digraph is like two friends holding hands to make one new sound.

quests.instruction: Which blend completes the word? __ow — it falls from the sky in winter.
quests.hint: Think of the word you want and say its first two sounds.
quests.explanation: “Snow” starts with sn. “Slow” is a real word too, but it does not match the clue.
quests.funFact: “Snow” has four letters but only three sounds: /s/ /n/ /ō/.

quests.instruction: Which blend completes the word? __ock — it hangs on a wall and tells you the time.
quests.hint: Say each choice. Block and flock are real words too, so use the clue.
quests.explanation: “Clock” starts with the blend cl. “Block” and “flock” are real words, but they do not tell the time.

quests.instruction: Which blend completes the word? __ag — it waves in the wind.
quests.hint: Say each choice and listen for the real word.
quests.explanation: “Flag” starts with fl. The other choices do not make a word that fits the clue.

quests.instruction: Stretch “trip” out into its sounds. Which list is right?
quests.hint: Tap each sound. There are two sounds before the vowel.
quests.explanation: “Trip” has 4 sounds: /t/ /r/ /i/ /p/. The blend tr has two sounds.

quests.instruction: Blend /g/ /l/ /a/ /d/. Which word do you hear?
quests.hint: Say each sound, then speed them up until they join into a word.
quests.explanation: /g/ /l/ /a/ /d/ blends into “glad”. “Gad” is missing the /l/ and “grad” has /r/ instead.
quests.funFact: When you blend, keep the sounds in order: g-l-a-d. Speed up until they melt into one word.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same first two sounds as “stop”?
quests.hint: Say the first two sounds of stop. Which word starts with the same pair?
quests.explanation: “Stop” and “stem” both begin with /s/ and /t/. “Slip” begins with sl and “spot” begins with sp.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with /cr/?
quests.hint: Say the first two sounds. The second one growls: /r/.
quests.explanation: “Crib” starts with /k/ and /r/. “Clip” starts with /k/ and /l/, and “rib” has only /r/.
quests.funFact: Crib, crab, crumb and cry all begin with the blend cr.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with /pr/, not /pl/?
quests.hint: Check the second sound at the start of each word: tongue up for /l/, tongue back for /r/.
quests.explanation: “Prop” starts with /p/ and /r/. “Plug” starts with /p/ and /l/, and “pug” has only /p/.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with /gr/, not /gl/?
quests.hint: Listen to the second sound at the start: /r/ growls and /l/ lifts your tongue.
quests.explanation: “Grin” starts with /g/ and /r/. “Glad” starts with /g/ and /l/, and “gum” has only /g/.

quests.instruction: Which word does NOT start with a blend?
quests.hint: Listen for two sounds at the start. Which word only has one?
quests.explanation: “Frog” starts with /f/ and /r/, and “flag” starts with /f/ and /l/. “Fish” starts with only /f/.
quests.funFact: Fish starts with a single /f/, while frog and flag start with /f/ plus another consonant.

quests.instruction: Which two letters blend at the start of “brush”?
quests.hint: Say brush slowly. Which sound comes right after /b/?
quests.explanation: “Brush” starts with /b/ and /r/. The blend bl would make “blush”, and gr would make “grush”, which is not a word.

quests.instruction: Which word has a blend at the start and a digraph at the end?
quests.hint: You need to find both: two starting sounds and one hushing sound at the end.
quests.explanation: “Flash” starts with the blend fl and ends with the digraph sh. “Flag” has no digraph and “fish” has no blend.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with /gl/?
quests.hint: Look for a throat sound followed by /l/.
quests.explanation: “Glue” starts with the blend gl. “Blue” starts with bl and “clue” starts with cl.
quests.funFact: Glue, blue and clue rhyme, but each one starts with a different blend.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with the same blend as “trip”?
quests.hint: Say the first two sounds of trip. Match them.
quests.explanation: “Trip” and “truck” both start with /t/ and /r/. “Drum” starts with dr and “grin” starts with gr.

quests.instruction: Which word has more sounds than “ship”?
quests.hint: Count the sounds in ship first. Then count the sounds in each choice.
quests.explanation: “Ship” has 3 sounds. “Slip” has 4, but “chip” and “shop” also have 3, since ch and sh are digraphs.
